sh:select Literal("
                    PREFIX nltl: <https://w3id.org/nltl/vocab#>
                    PREFIX qudt: <http://qudt.org/schema/qudt/>
                    PREFIX xsd: <http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema#>
                    SELECT $this
                    WHERE {
                        $this nltl:iceAccretionLikely true ;
                              nltl:continuousSurfaceProjectedArea ?continuousArea ;
                              nltl:discontinuousSurfaceProjectedArea ?discontinuousArea ;
                              nltl:continuousSurfaceStaticMoment ?continuousMoment ;
                              nltl:discontinuousSurfaceStaticMoment ?discontinuousMoment .
                        ?continuousArea qudt:numericValue ?continuousAreaValue .
                        ?discontinuousArea qudt:numericValue ?discontinuousAreaValue .
                        ?continuousMoment qudt:numericValue ?continuousMomentValue .
                        ?discontinuousMoment qudt:numericValue ?discontinuousMomentValue .
                        FILTER (
                            ABS(?discontinuousAreaValue - (?continuousAreaValue * 1.05)) >
                            (ABS(?continuousAreaValue * 1.05) * 0.000001 + 0.000000001)
                            ||
                            ABS(?discontinuousMomentValue - (?continuousMomentValue * 1.10)) >
                            (ABS(?continuousMomentValue * 1.10) * 0.000001 + 0.000000001)
                        )
                    }
                ") ] ] , [ sh:property [ sh:datatype xsd:boolean ; sh:hasValue Literal("false" = False, datatype=xsd:boolean) ; sh:maxCount Literal("1", datatype=xsd:integer) ; sh:minCount Literal("1", datatype=xsd:integer) ; sh:path <https://w3id.org/nltl/vocab#iceAccretionLikely> ] ]

blocker.detail: The negative rejects and the intended-only repair passes, but one or more reported logical/SPARQL/complex-path failures lack a reviewed semantic correspondence. No strict credit is inferred from verdicts alone.

likely_cause.detail: The independently valid intended-only counterfactual still rejects or violation meaning is not established. Reports are saved; no context-vs-generator cause is invented.
